  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">i</font></p>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit 10.2</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">ARTICLE I<br><br>DEFINITIONS</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.01	&#x201c;Account&#x201d; shall mean the account maintained on behalf of each Participant or Former Participant which reflects the Participant&#x2019;s or Former Participant&#x2019;s Elective Deferrals, Matching Contributions, if any, and Interest.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.02	&#x201c;Administrative Committee&#x201d; shall mean the Administrative Committee of the Schlumberger Limited Pension Plan.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.03	&#x201c;Affiliate&#x201d; shall mean any corporation in which the shares owned or controlled directly or indirectly by Schlumberger Limited shall represent eighty percent (80%) or more of the voting power of the issued and outstanding capital stock of such corporation. Affiliate shall also include any corporation or other trade or business which, together with Schlumberger Limited, is &#x201c;under common control&#x201d; as determined in accordance with Section 414(b) or (c) of the Code, as may be modified by Section 415(h) of the Code.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.04	&#x201c;Base Compensation&#x201d; shall mean Compensation, excluding any bonus or incentive payment.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.05	&#x201c;Beneficiary&#x201d; shall mean the individual designated by a Participant or Former Participant in accordance with Section 3.03 who is entitled to benefits under the Plan in the event of a Participant&#x2019;s or Former Participant&#x2019;s death.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.06	&#x201c;Board of Directors&#x201d; shall mean the Board of Directors of Schlumberger Technology Corporation.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.07	&#x201c;Change in Control&#x201d; and &#x201c;409&#x410; Change in Control&#x201d; shall have the meaning ascribed to it in Section 8.01.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.08	&#x201c;Code&#x201d; shall mean the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as may be amended.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.09	&#x201c;Company&#x201d; shall mean Schlumberger Limited.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.10	&#x201c;Compensation&#x201d; shall mean the aggregate amount of compensation paid by the Employer or an Affiliate to an Employee during a calendar year, including normal salary, wages, overtime compensation, commissions, bonuses and salary deferral amounts under Section 401(k) of the Code, if any, and excluding:</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:6.667%;text-indent:-7.143%;padding-left:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(a)	compensation for employment during any period in which an individual is not an Employee;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:6.667%;text-indent:-7.143%;padding-left:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(b)	any special payment of compensation, including but not limited to, income arising pursuant to the exercise of a stock option, field meal allowance, early retirement payments, severance payments, pay in lieu of vacation, tuition reimbursement, moving allowances;</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1</font></p>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit 10.2</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:6.667%;text-indent:-7.143%;padding-left:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(c)	payment by the Employer on behalf of the Participant to this or any other qualified or non-qualified pension, profit sharing, savings or other employee benefit plan.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.11	&#x201c;Disability&#x201d; or &#x201c;Disabled&#x201d; means (A) the Participant is unable to engage in any substantial gainful activity by reason of any medically determinable physical or mental impairment that can be expected to result in death or can be expected to last for a continuous period of not less than 12 months or (B) the Participant is, by reason of any medically determinable physical or mental impairment that can be expected to result in death or can be expected to last for a continuous period of not less than 12 months, receiving income replacement benefits for a period of not less than three months under an accident and health plan covering employees of the Company or any Affiliate.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.12	&#x201c;Elective Deferrals&#x201d; shall mean the amount of Excess Compensation an Eligible Employee elects to defer in accordance with Section 4.01 of the Plan.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.13	Eligible Employee&#x201d; shall mean an Employee who is on a U.S. based payroll or is seconded by an Employer to a foreign country and is on the payroll of Schlumberger Resources, Inc.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.14	&#x201c;Employee&#x201d; shall mean an employee of the Employer who is employed by and carried on the payroll of the Employer and who is eligible to participate in the Schlumberger Limited Savings and Retirement Plan.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.15	&#x201c;Employer&#x201d; shall mean Schlumberger Limited and any Affiliate who has adopted the Plan for the benefit of its Eligible Employees.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.16	&#x201c;Enrollment Period&#x201d; shall mean the 30-day period beginning each June 1.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.17	&#x201c;Excess Compensation&#x201d; shall mean the amount of Compensation paid to an Employee during a calendar year in excess of $330,000, as such amount may be adjusted in accordance with Section 401(a)(17) of the Code.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.18	&#x201c;Former Participant&#x201d; means an Employee of the Employer or an Affiliate who was a Participant and continues to have an Account under the Plan.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.19	&#x201c;Interest&#x201d; shall mean the amount of interest allocated to a Participant&#x2019;s Account. Such amount shall mirror the interest earnings of the relevant Investment Options, as chosen by the Participant pursuant to Section 4.04.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.20	&#x201c;Investment Option&#x201d; shall mean each investment option made available from time to time to participants in the applicable qualified defined contribution plan of the Employer in which such Participant or Former Participant is a member.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.21	&#x201c;Matching Contribution&#x201d; shall mean the amount contributed by the Employer in accordance with Section 4.02.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.22	&#x201c;Non-Elective Contributions&#x201d; shall mean the amount contributed by the Employer in accordance with Section 4.03.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">2</font></p>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit 10.2</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.23	&#x201c;Participant&#x201d; shall mean an Eligible Employee who meets the eligibility requirements of Section 2.02 and has commenced, but not terminated, participation in the Plan in accordance with the provisions of Article III of the Plan.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.24	&#x201c;Plan&#x201d; shall mean the Schlumberger Limited Restoration Savings Plan as set forth herein and as may be amended.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.25	&#x201c;Plan Year&#x201d; shall mean the calendar year.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.26	&#x201c;Qualified Defined Benefit Plans&#x201d; shall mean the Schlumberger Limited Pension Plan and the Schlumberger Technology Corporation Pension Plan.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.27	&#x201c;Spouse&#x201d; shall mean the person, if any, legally married pursuant to the laws of the State or country in which such marriage was performed to a Participant at the latest of (i) the time of the Participant&#x2019;s death prior to retirement, (ii) the time of the Participant&#x2019;s retirement, or (iii) the time the Participant&#x2019;s benefits are to commence; provided, however, that this definition of &#x201c;Spouse&#x201d; shall include a same sex Spouse effective no earlier than (a) September 16, 2013, or (b) if prior to September 16, 2013, such Participant and same sex Spouse resided in a State or the District of Columbia that legally recognized their marriage, June 26, 2013 (or such later date as the Participant and his or her Spouse became residents of such State or the District of Columbia but in no event later than September 16, 2013).</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.28	&#x201c;Termination of Employment&#x201d; shall mean &#x201c;separation from service,&#x201d; as defined in Section 1.409A-1(h) of the U.S. Treasury regulations, with an Employer for any reason other than a transfer between Employers.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.29	&#x201c;Transfer Date&#x201d; shall mean the date a Transfer Employee meets the requirements to become an Eligible Employee.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.30	&#x201c;Transfer Employee&#x201d; shall mean an individual who is an employee compensated on a non-U.S. payroll of an Employer or an Affiliate and transfers into a position that qualifies him or her as an Eligible Employee.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.31	&#x201c;Trust&#x201d; shall mean the Schlumberger Executive Deferred Compensation Trust, a grantor trust.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">1.32	&#x201c;Vested&#x201d; shall mean non-forfeitable.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Unless the context of the document dearly provides otherwise, all masculine pronouns when used in the Plan shall be deemed to include the feminine gender and any feminine pronouns shall be deemed to include the masculine gender.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">ARTICLE II<br><br>ELIGIBILITY</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">2.01	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Employer Determination</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.  Each year, prior to the last day of the Enrollment Period, the Employer shall determine those Eligible Employees who may participate in the Plan</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">3</font></p>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit 10.2</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">during the subsequent Plan Year. Such determination shall be made in accordance with the requirements set forth in Section 2.02.  The Employer may also designate Employees who are newly hired or are transferred to the Employer (each, an &#x201c;Initial Eligibility Event&#x201d;) as Eligible Employees regardless of the timing of such Initial Eligibility Event.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">2.02	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Eligibility Requirements</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.  An Eligible Employee may participate in the Plan if such Eligible Employee is projected to have Excess Compensation in the subsequent Plan Year. In determining whether an Eligible Employee is projected to have Excess Compensation, the Employer shall look to the Eligible Employee&#x2019;s Base Compensation for the then current calendar year and the maximum projected bonus potential payable in the first quarter of the subsequent Plan Year based on the Employee&#x2019;s current grade and salary level. If the sum of the Eligible Employee&#x2019;s Base Compensation and the maximum projected bonus potential exceeds the limitation set forth in Section 401(a)(17) of the Code, the Employee is eligible to participate in the Plan during the subsequent Plan Year.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Subject to Section 4.01, an Employee initially designated as an Eligible Employee during a Plan Year who is projected to have Excess Compensation during such Plan Year may elect to defer Base Compensation that is also Excess Compensation.  Such election shall remain in effect until the first day of the Plan Year following the end of the next Enrollment Period to occur after the Employee&#x2019;s designation as an Eligible Employee.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">The Plan is intended to qualify for the exemptions provided under Title I of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 for plans that are not tax-qualified and that are maintained primarily to provide deferred compensation for a select group of management or highly compensated employees.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">ARTICLE III<br><br>PARTICIPATION</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">3.01	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Commencement of Participation</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. During each Enrollment Period, an Eligible Employee who meets the requirements of Section 2.02 may elect to participate in the Plan by completing the necessary deferral election requirements during the Enrollment Period.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">In order to become effective, an Eligible Employee&#x2019;s deferral election must be completed on or before the last day of the Enrollment Period. No elections shall be accepted after the Enrollment Period ends.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">An Eligible Employee who elects to participate within an Enrollment Period shall become a Participant on the first day of the next following Plan Year.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Notwithstanding the above, and subject to Section 4.01, an Employee initially designated as an Eligible Employee during a Plan Year may make a deferral election within 30 days following the date such Employee is initially designated as an Eligible Employee.  Such election shall remain in effect until the first day of the Plan Year following the next Enrollment Period.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">4</font></p>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit 10.2</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Notwithstanding the foregoing, and subject to Section 4.04, Transfer Employees may commence participation in the Plan in the year in which the Transfer Date occurs regardless of any election to defer Compensation.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">3.02	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Cessation of Participation</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. A Participant shall cease to be a Participant as of the earliest of (i) the date on which the Plan terminates in a manner consistent with Section 409A; (ii) the date on which the Participant is no longer an Eligible Employee; (iii) the first day of any Plan Year in which the Participant fails to meet the eligibility requirements of Section 2.02; or (iv) the first day of any Plan Year in which the Participant does not elect to participate or fails to enroll within the applicable Enrollment Period.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">A Participant who ceases to be a Participant in accordance with (ii), (iii) or (iv) of the preceding paragraph shall become a Former Participant if such Participant retains an Account under the Plan.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">3.03	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Beneficiary Designation</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Subject to the requirements of this Section 3.03, a Participant or Former Participant may designate, in writing, a Beneficiary who is entitled to receive the benefits hereunder in the event of the Participant&#x2019;s or Former Participant&#x2019;s death.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">The Beneficiary of a Participant or Former Participant who is married is automatically the Participant&#x2019;s or Former Participant&#x2019;s Spouse. A married Participant or Former Participant may designate a Beneficiary other than the Spouse only if such Spouse consents, in writing, to such designation. In order to be effective, such spousal consent must (i) acknowledge the effect of waiving the benefit such Spouse is otherwise entitled to receive; (ii) consent to the designated Beneficiary; (iii) acknowledge that the Beneficiary designation is not valid unless the Spouse agrees to such designation and (iv) be witnessed by a notary public or authorized Plan representative.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">A Participant or Former Participant who is not married may designate any individual or person as Beneficiary.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">A Beneficiary designation shall only become effective upon receipt by the Employer. Any Beneficiary designation filed with the Employer shall supersede any prior designation on file upon receipt by the Employer.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">In the absence of any Beneficiary designation, payments upon the death of the Participant or Former Participant shall be made to the first named Beneficiary or class of Beneficiaries, of the following successive Beneficiaries who survive the Participant or Former Participant: (i) the surviving Spouse, if any; (ii) one share to each child of the Participant or Former Participant, whether or not the child is then living, except that the share of a deceased child of the Participant or Former Participant shall be divided, per stirpes, among the then living descendants of such deceased child; (iii) father and mother, equally, or to the survivor; (iv) surviving brothers and sisters, equally; (v) a duly appointed executor or administrator of the Participant&#x2019;s or Former Participant&#x2019;s estate. For purposes of this paragraph, &#x201c;child&#x201d; &#x201c;children&#x201d; or &#x201c;descendants&#x201d; shall include legally adopted children.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">5</font></p>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit 10.2</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">ARTICLE IV<br><br>CONTRIBUTIONS</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">4.01	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Elective Deferral Amounts</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Effective for Elective Deferrals occurring after the June 2012 Enrollment Period, an Eligible Employee may irrevocably elect to defer, in any whole percentage, an amount from 1% to 50% of such Eligible Employee&#x2019;s Excess Compensation.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">A Participant&#x2019;s Elective Deferral shall go into effect as of the first payroll period in which such Participant receives Excess Compensation and shall remain in effect throughout the Plan Year. A Participant may increase or decrease an Elective Deferral only during the Enrollment Period with respect to Elective Deferrals for the next following Plan Year.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Elective Deferrals shall be paid to the Trust as soon as practicable following the payroll period in which such amount would have been payable to the Participant in cash, but for such Participant&#x2019;s election to defer.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">An Employee who becomes an Eligible Employee on or prior to the last day of the Enrollment Period may also make an election to defer, up to the limits set forth above, Base Compensation that is also Excess Compensation for the remainder of the Plan Year.  An Employee who becomes an Eligible Employee after the last day of the Enrollment Period may make an election to defer, up to the limits set forth above: (i) Base Compensation that is also Excess Compensation earned for the remainder of the Plan Year and (ii) Base Compensation that is also Excess Compensation earned in the next following Plan Year.  For purposes of clarity, an Employee&#x2019;s deferral election shall remain in effect until the first day of the Plan Year following the next Enrollment Period to occur after the Employee&#x2019;s designation as an Eligible Employee.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">4.02	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Matching Contributions</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Each year the Employer shall determine the Matching Contribution.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Effective January 1, 2013, for Participants who were hired prior to October 1, 2004 and for Participants who did not elect to cease participation in the Qualified Defined Benefit Plans effective January 1, 2005, the Matching Contribution shall be equal to 50% of the first 6% of each participant&#x2019;s Elective Deferrals made during the Plan Year.  Such contributions shall be made by the Employer as soon as administratively practicable following each payroll period.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Effective January 1, 2013, for Participants who were hired on or after October 1, 2004 and for Participants who elected to cease participation in the Qualified Defined Benefit Plans effective January 1, 2005, the Matching Contribution shall be equal to 100% of the first 6% of each participant&#x2019;s Elective Deferrals made during the Plan Year.  Such contributions shall be made by the Employer as soon as administratively practicable following each payroll period.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Notwithstanding the foregoing paragraph, for a Participant who was most recently hired on or after November 1, 2020, and on or after such hire date is participating in the Schlumberger Limited Supplementary Benefit Plan as a &#x201c;Returning Officer&#x201d; as such term is defined in the Schlumberger Limited Supplementary Benefit Plan, the Matching Contribution shall be equal to 50% of the first 6% of such Participant&#x2019;s Elective Deferrals made during the Plan Year.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">6</font></p>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit 10.2</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Such contributions shall be made by the Employer as soon as administratively practicable following each payroll period.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Effective January 1, 2024, all Participants shall receive an additional Matching Contribution equal to 50% of each Participant&#x2019;s Elective Deferrals made during the Plan Year which exceed 6% of such Participant&#x2019;s Excess Compensation up to 10% of such Participant&#x2019;s Excess Compensation.  Such contributions shall be made by the Employer as soon as administratively practicable following each payroll period.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">4.03	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Non-Elective Contributions.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> Effective January 1, 2018, for Transfer Employees who are paid an annual incentive bonus from the U.S. payroll of an Employer after the Transfer Date and in the same calendar year as the Transfer  Date, a Non-Elective Contribution shall be made equal to the Matching Contribution that would have been made had the Transfer Employee elected to defer 6% of the portion of such annual incentive bonus that would constitute Excess Compensation. Such contributions shall be made by the Employer as soon as administratively practicable following the payroll period in which the applicable annual incentive bonus is paid.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:13.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Effective January 1, 2024, all Participants (as determined as of the end of each Plan Year) shall receive a Non-Elective Contribution equal to 2% of such Participant&#x2019;s Excess Compensation for such Plan Year.  Such contributions shall be made by the Employer as soon as administratively practicable following the close of the Plan Year.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">4.04	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Interest Options. </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">In accordance with procedures established by the Administrative Committee, each Participant may designate the specific Investment Option with respect to which his Account shall be deemed to be invested.  The Participant may designate, in 1% increments, the amount to be invested in each Investment Option.  If a Participant fails to make a proper designation, then his Account shall be deemed invested in the Short-term Fixed Income Fund.  A Participant may change such designation with respect to future Matching Contributions and Elective Deferrals, as well as with respect to amounts already credited to his Account, provided such change(s) are made in accordance with the procedures established by the Administrative Committee.  The Administrative Committee shall determine from time to time each of the funds made available under this Plan and may change any such determinations at any time.  Nothing herein shall obligate the Company to invest any part of its assets in any of the funds.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">ARTICLE V<br><br>ALLOCATION OF CONTRIBUTIONS AND INTEREST</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">5.01	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Allocation of Elective Deferrals</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. As of each pay period, the Employer shall allocate the Elective Deferrals made during such pay period to a Participant&#x2019;s Account.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">5.02	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Allocation of Matching Contributions</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. As of each pay period, the Employer shall allocate the Matching Contributions, if any, among the Accounts of Participants or Former Participants who made Elective Deferrals during such pay period.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">5.03	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Allocation of Non-Elective Contributions.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> For Non-Elective Contributions relating to the annual incentive bonuses of Transferred Employees, as of the pay period to which the contributions relate, the Employer shall allocate the Non-Elective Contributions, if any, among</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">7</font></p>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:right;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit 10.2</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">the Accounts of Transfer Employees during such pay period.  For all other Non-Elective Contributions, as of the end of each Plan Year, the Employer shall allocate the Non-Elective Contribution, if any, among the Accounts of Participants (as determined as of the end of each Plan Year).</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">5.04	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Allocation of Interest</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">. Interest shall be allocated to a Participant&#x2019;s or Former Participant&#x2019;s Account on a daily basis. Such amount shall be allocated based on the amount then standing in such Account.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">ARTICLE VI<br><br>VESTING</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">6.01	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Vesting</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">.  Subject to the provisions of Section 6.02, a Participant, or Former Participant shall have a Vested right to benefits in accordance with this Section 6.01:</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:6.667%;text-indent:-7.143%;padding-left:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">(a)	A Participant or Former Participant shall be 100% Vested in their Elective Deferrals, plus any Interest thereon, at all times.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:13.2%;text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x410; Participant or Former Participant, who is also eligible to participate in the Schlumberger Limited Savings and Retirement Plan, shall have a Vested right to Matching Contributions allocated to such Participant&#x2019;s or Former Participant&#x2019;s Account, plus any Interest thereon, in accordance with the following schedule:</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:13.2%;text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x410; Participant or Former Participant, who is also eligible to participate in the Schlumberger Limited Savings and Retirement Plan, shall have a fully Vested right to Non-Elective Contributions allocated to such Participant&#x2019;s or Former Participant&#x2019;s Account, plus any Interest thereon, upon the completion of three years of Service.  Notwithstanding the foregoing sentence, Non-Elective Contributions relating to the annual incentive bonuses of Transferred Employees shall be subject to the same vesting schedule as would be applicable to Matching Contributions as described above.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:13.2%;text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;Service&#x201d; shall include any period of &#x201c;Active Service&#x201d; as such term is defined in the applicable qualified defined contribution plan of the Employer in which such Participant or Former Participant is a member.</font></p>
  <p style="text-indent:0;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">8</font></p>
